importantNotes: The Christ hymn (1:15-20) is one of the most exalted descriptions of Jesus in Scripture.
'In Christ all the fullness of deity dwells in bodily form' (2:9) — Jesus is fully God.
Paul never visited Colossae — the church was planted by Epaphras.
Colossians is the antidote to any teaching that says Christ is not enough.
'Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord' (3:23).

chapters.1: The supremacy of Christ — firstborn over all creation; Paul's prayer and ministry.
chapters.2: Complete in Christ; warnings against hollow philosophy, legalism, and false mysticism.
chapters.3: Set your minds on things above; put off the old self; put on the new; household rules.
chapters.4: Instructions for prayer and witness; greetings; Tychicus and Onesimus sent.
